title: 第一卷 第19章 哪里来的怪物第一卷 第20章 研究体竟然死而复生了
lines: 怪不得这个世界的计算方式，和他的前世一模一样！
比如用“米”来计量长度，而非丈、尺，就连口语、文字，都惊人地相似！
陈渊彻底懵了！
难道三千年前从神魔遗迹里挖出来的那个人，和他、李伟一样，都来自地球？
就像他和李伟一样，他之所以比李伟早一年醒来，是因为……他被提前挖出来了？
陈渊思绪沸腾、心神大乱之际，场中的战斗依旧在激烈进行。
随着无相士尽数化作凶兽，战斗的破坏力变得愈发惊人。
“轰隆隆……”
无数参天大树被拦腰折断，化作漫天碎屑，地面被打得坑坑洼洼、满目疮痍！
可令陈渊、陈昭宁，甚至是莫洪都无比震惊的是，陆承锋的战力远比想象中更强！
他竟是凭着一己之力，将那些凶兽一一撕碎！
“他至少有着黄庭境大圆满的战力！”
陈昭宁收回心神，望着如同人形凶兽般的陆承锋，满脸震撼地开口。
莫洪瞳孔骤缩，心中的惊骇早已翻江倒海！
短短片刻之间，陆承锋便将所有凶兽斩杀殆尽！
就连武桥镇的衙役、王家的护卫，也无一生还。
“这到底是……哪里来的怪物？”
莫洪心中生出强烈的退意，正想转身退入树林，身前却突然被一片黑暗笼罩！
下一瞬，两只如钢铁般坚硬的手掌，死死扣住了他的肩膀。
陆承锋的面容依旧被长发遮盖，发丝缝隙中传来低沉沙哑的嘶吼，吓得莫洪灵魂都在战栗。
“阁……阁下……我可是……”
莫洪浑身哆嗦，话未说完，眼前便骤然一黑！
嘶啦！
陆承锋双手猛地用力，竟直接将莫洪的身躯撕裂成两半！
莫洪的话语，也随之戛然而止。
看到这般血腥恐怖的一幕，陈渊和陈昭宁双眼圆睁，呼吸都瞬间凝滞了。
场中到处都是残肢断臂，密密麻麻的血肉碎块堆积在一起，触目惊心。
唯有那尊高大魁梧、身着麻衣的身影，依旧巍峨地伫立在血泊之中。
高大身影发出低沉的嘶吼，像是饿极了的凶兽，在四处搜寻猎物。
蓦地，他缓缓转动身形，目光直直投向陈渊所在的方向！
陈渊和陈昭宁的瞳孔，骤然收缩成针孔大小！
一股被凶兽恶狼盯上的寒意席卷全身，连血液都仿佛凝固了。
唰！
在两人的瞳孔倒影中，那高大的身影瞬间变得模糊，朝着他们飞速逼近，身影在视野中急速放大！
“不好！”
陈渊失声惊呼，想要侧身躲开，可对方的速度太快，一只大手瞬间抓住了他的脖子，将他高高举了起来。
强烈的窒息感瞬间席卷全身，陈渊只觉得眼前发黑，意识渐渐模糊，仿佛就要坠入永恒的黑暗。
“爹爹！”
一声焦急的呼喊在耳边响起，像是来自遥远的天边，带着哭腔，带着焦急，瞬间唤醒了陈渊的一丝意识。
砰！
下一秒，陈渊重重跌倒在地，大口大口地喘着粗气，贪婪地汲取着新鲜空气。
眼前的高大身影已然停下了所有动作，呆呆地望向马背上的糯米。
content_en:
No wonder the calculation method in this world is exactly the same as in his previous life!
For example, "meter" is used to measure length instead of feet or feet. Even the spoken and written words are surprisingly similar!
Chen Yuan was completely confused!
Could it be that the man dug out from the ruins of gods and demons three thousand years ago, like him and Li Wei, came from the earth?
Just like him and Li Wei, the reason why he woke up a year earlier than Li Wei was because... he was dug out in advance?
While Chen Yuan's thoughts were boiling and his mind was in chaos, the battle in the field was still going on fiercely.
As all the phaseless men turned into ferocious beasts, the destructive power of the battle became more and more astonishing.
"Rumble..."
Countless towering trees were broken in half and turned into debris all over the sky. The ground was pockmarked and devastated!
But what shocked Chen Yuan, Chen Zhaoning, and even Mo Hong was that Lu Chengfeng's combat power was far stronger than imagined!
He actually tore those ferocious beasts into pieces one by one with his own strength!
"He at least has the combat power of Huang Ting Realm Dzogchen!"
Chen Zhaoning withdrew his mind, looked at Lu Chengfeng who looked like a ferocious beast in human form, and spoke with shock on his face.
Mo Hong's pupils shrank suddenly, and the horror in his heart was already overwhelming!
In just a few moments, Lu Chengfeng killed all the ferocious beasts!
Even the government officials of Wuqiao Town and the guards of the Wang family did not survive.
“Where on earth is this monster from?”
Mo Hong had a strong intention to retreat in his heart, and just as he was about to turn around and retreat into the woods, he was suddenly enveloped in darkness!
The next moment, two hands as hard as steel clasped his shoulders.
"Uh-huh..."
Lu Chengfeng's face was still covered by long hair, and a low and hoarse roar came from the gap in the hair, which scared Mo Hong's soul to tremble.
"Your Excellency...Your Excellency...I am..."
Mo Hong was trembling all over. Before he finished speaking, his eyes suddenly went dark!
Hiss!
Lu Chengfeng used his hands so hard that he tore Mo Hong's body in half!
Mo Hong's words also stopped abruptly.
Seeing such a bloody and terrifying scene, Chen Yuan and Chen Zhaoning's eyes widened, and their breathing suddenly froze.
There were stumps of limbs and broken arms everywhere in the field, and dense pieces of flesh and blood piled together, which was shocking.
Only the tall and burly figure, dressed in sackcloth, still stood majestically in the pool of blood.
"Uhhh!!!"
The tall figure let out a low roar, like a hungry beast searching for prey everywhere.
Suddenly, he slowly turned around and looked straight in the direction of Chen Yuan!
The pupils of Chen Yuan and Chen Zhaoning suddenly shrank to the size of pinholes!
A chill of being targeted by ferocious beasts and wolves swept through his body, and even his blood seemed to freeze.
Uh-huh!
In the reflection of the two people's pupils, the tall figure instantly became blurred, approaching them quickly, and the figure rapidly enlarged in the field of vision!
"Not good!"
Chen Yuan exclaimed and wanted to dodge sideways, but the opponent's speed was too fast. A big hand instantly grabbed his neck and lifted him up high.
A strong sense of suffocation swept through his body instantly. Chen Yuan felt that his eyes were turning black and his consciousness gradually blurred, as if he was about to fall into eternal darkness.
"Daddy!"
An anxious cry sounded in his ears, as if coming from the distant horizon, with a cry and anxiety, instantly awakening Chen Yuan's consciousness.
Bang!
The next second, Chen Yuan fell heavily to the ground, breathing heavily and greedily sucking in fresh air.
The tall figure in front of him had stopped all movements and stared blankly at Nuomi on the horse.
